contentList.content: FeiYu

FeiYu warriors are masters of feather weapons and agile combat techniques. They wield the FeiYu dice system, capable of executing various elegant maneuvers, possess eagle-like keen vision, and display feather-light yet deadly attack styles in battle. 3rd Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="FeiYu_SuperiorityDice">FeiYu Dice</LSTag>, learn FeiYu maneuvers 7th Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="FeiYu_YingYan">Eagle Eye</LSTag>, learn additional maneuvers 10th Level - FeiYu dice upgrade to d10, learn additional maneuvers 15th Level - <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="FeiYu_Mastery">FeiYu Mastery</LSTag> 18th Level - FeiYu dice upgrade to d12
FeiYu Dice (4)
Master the essence of FeiYu maneuvers. Gain 4 FeiYu dice that can be used to execute FeiYu maneuvers. FeiYu dice are restored on a short rest.
FeiYu Dice (5)
Your mastery of FeiYu maneuvers becomes more proficient. FeiYu dice increase to 5.
FeiYu Dice (6)
Your mastery of FeiYu maneuvers becomes more exquisite. FeiYu dice increase to 6.
FeiYu Dice (7)
Your mastery of FeiYu maneuvers approaches master level. FeiYu dice increase to 7.
FeiYu Dice (8)
Your mastery of FeiYu maneuvers reaches the pinnacle. FeiYu dice increase to 8.
FeiYu Dice (d8)
The basic form of FeiYu maneuvers. FeiYu dice are d8.
FeiYu Dice (d10)
The essence of FeiYu maneuvers is enhanced. FeiYu dice upgrade to d10, becoming more powerful.
FeiYu Dice (d12)
FeiYu maneuvers reach the pinnacle. FeiYu dice upgrade to d12, achieving ultimate power.
Eagle Eye

Possess eagle-like keen vision and perception. Gain 60 feet <LSTag Tooltip="Darkvision">Darkvision</LSTag>, immunity to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blinded</LSTag> condition, and 50% increased range for ranged weapons.
FeiYu Mastery
Your mastery of FeiYu maneuvers reaches perfection. Once per turn, you can use a FeiYu maneuver without expending a FeiYu die.
Meteor Chain Feather

Swift consecutive attacks like meteors. Make a weapon attack against the target, dealing weapon damage + FeiYu die damage, then make an additional attack against another nearby enemy. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Meteor Chain Feather (Enhanced)
Enhanced version of Meteor Chain Feather. After the weapon attack against the target, you can consecutively attack 2 additional enemies. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Meteor Chain Feather (Master)
Master version of Meteor Chain Feather. After the weapon attack against the target, you can consecutively attack 3 additional enemies. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Meteor Chain Feather·Chain
Chain attack effect of Meteor Chain Feather. Make an additional weapon attack against nearby enemies.
Wind Swept Feather
Area attack that sweeps like a gale. Make weapon attacks against all enemies within 3 meters, dealing weapon damage + FeiYu die damage. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Wind Swept Feather (Enhanced)
Enhanced version of Wind Swept Feather. Attack range expands to 4.5 meters. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Wind Swept Feather (Master)
Master version of Wind Swept Feather. Attack range expands to 6 meters. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Startling Swan Feather

Elegant splitting attack like a startling swan. Make a weapon attack against the primary target, dealing weapon damage + FeiYu die damage, then deal half damage to 3 surrounding enemies. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Startling Swan Feather (Enhanced)
Enhanced version of Startling Swan Feather. Deal half damage to 5 surrounding enemies. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Startling Swan Feather (Master)
Master version of Startling Swan Feather. Deal half damage to 7 surrounding enemies. Cost: 1 Action Point, 1 FeiYu Die
Startling Swan Feather·Splash
Splash damage effect of Startling Swan Feather. Deal half weapon damage to surrounding enemies.
Startling Swan Feather·Splash (Enhanced)
Splash damage effect of enhanced Startling Swan Feather. Affects a larger area.
Startling Swan Feather·Splash (Master)
Splash damage effect of master Startling Swan Feather. Affects the largest area.
